test_read: the NUAA test of the new models is read once, by evaluate, after every check that does not need it. check-inputs: this configuration; the PR A configuration and what it pins; the configuration of the runs (pad_anet_run.load_config and load_pins: the PR A package, the trial, the plan, the PR #27 and #28 configurations); the amended protocol of the PR B package; the public status.json, results.json and units.csv of the C2 evaluation 20261121-ARCHEVAL-332fbdf and its restricted SHA256SUMS with the 48 <p4|p12>_<network>_fold<k>_seed<s>_test_scores.csv it lists (the C2 test scores, already published as aggregates: read to reproduce C2 exactly); when the runs are recorded, their status.json, run.log, SHA256SUMS and the files they list. evaluate, in addition: what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (manifests, cache, extracted frames, cells and folds runs); the dev scores and BN statistics of each evaluable new model; its checkpoint; after the dev reproduction of every model, the fold schema and the test frames of each fold, assembled once
